1: Allah un farishton ki qasam khata hai jo kafiron ki rooh sakhti aur durushti se kheenchte hain.
2: Aur un farishton ki bhi qasam khata hai jo mominon ki rooh naram aur aasan tareeqe se nikalte hain.
3: Aur un farishton ki bhi qasam khata hai jo Allah ke hukm se aasman se zameen ki taraf tairte hue aate hain.
4: Aur un farishton ki bhi qasam khata hai jo Allah ka hukm bajaa lane mein ek doosre se aage barhte hain.
5: Aur un farishton ki bhi qasam khata hai jo Allah ke us faisle ko nafiz karte hain jis ka us ne unhein hukm diya, yani woh farishte jo bandon ke aamaal par muqarrar hain. Allah in sab ki qasam kha kar farmata hai ke woh unhein hisaab aur badle ke liye zaroor dobara zinda karega.
6: Us din jab pehli baar soor phoonka jayega aur zameen kaanp uthegi.
7: Us ke baad doosra phoonka aayega.
8: Us din baaz logon ke dil khauf se bhare honge.
9: Un ke chehron par zillat ke asaraat zahir honge.
10: Woh kahenge: “Kya hum marne ke baad dobara zinda kiye jayenge?”
11: “Jab hum gal-sar kar khokhli haddiyan ban jayenge, kya us ke baad hum lautaye jayenge?”
12: Woh kehte hain: “Agar hum lautaye gaye, to yeh lautna ghaate ka sauda hoga, aur lautne wala nuqsan uthayega.”
13: Dobara zinda hona aasan hai. Yeh phoonkne par muqarrar farishte ki sirf ek chikh hogi.
14: Phir achanak sab zameen ki satah par zinda honge, haalanke pehle woh us ke andar murda thay.
15: Aey Rasool ﷺ, kya aap ke paas Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki, aur un ke Rubb ki, aur un ke dushman Firaun ki khabar pahunchi hai?
16: Jab un ke Rubb ne, jo paak hai, unhein Tuwa ki mubarak waadi mein pukara.
17: Jo baatein us ne unhein kahin, un mein yeh thi: “Firaun ke paas jao; beshak woh zulm aur takabbur mein hadd se barh gaya hai.”
18: “Phir us se kaho: aey Firaun, kya tu kufr aur gunahon se paak hona chahta hai?”
19: “Main tujhe tere Rubb ka raasta dikhaun, jis ne tujhe paida kiya aur tujhe rizq diya, taake tu us se dare aur us ki razamandi ke mutabiq amal kare, aur un cheezon se bache jo us ka gazab laati hain.”
20: Phir Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne usey woh bari nishani dikhai jo is baat ka saboot thi ke woh apne Rubb ki taraf se Rasool hain, yani haath aur lathi.
21: Firaun ne in nishaniyon ko jhutlane ke siwa kuch na kiya, aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki di hui hidayat ki nafarmani ki.
22: Phir woh us cheez par iman lane se munh pher kar chal diya jo Moosa (alaihis salaam) laaye thay.
23: Aur us ne apni tawajjoh is par lagai ke lashkar jama kare aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) par ghalib aa jaye. Us ne apni qaum ko pukar kar kaha:
24: “Main tumhara sab se bara rubb hoon; tumhein mere siwa kisi ki farmanbardari nahin karni.”
25: Pas Allah ne usey pakar liya aur duniya mein usey samandar mein duba kar saza di, aur aakhirat mein usey sakht tareen azaab mein daal kar saza dega.
26: Beshak duniya aur aakhirat mein Firaun ko meri di hui saza mein us shaks ke liye nasihat hai jo Allah se darta hai, kyunke wohi nasihat se faida uthata hai.
27: Aey qayamat ko jhutlane walon, kya tumhein paida karna Allah ke liye zyada mushkil hai, ya us aasman ko jo us ne banaya?
28: Us ne aasman ki chhat ko buland kiya aur usey hamwar banaya; us mein koi shikan, daraar ya nuqs nahin.
29: Aur us ne sooraj doobne par us ki raat ko tareek kiya, aur us ke nikalne par us ki roshni ko zahir kiya.
30: Aur aasmanon ko banane ke baad zameen ko us ne phailaya aur us mein us ke faide rakh diye.
31: Us ne us mein se behte chashmon ki soorat mein paani nikala, aur us par woh podey ugaye jinhein chaupaye charte hain.
32: Aur us ne zameen par pahaaron ko jama diya.
33: Aey logon, yeh sab tumhare faide ke liye hai aur tumhare chaupayon ke faide ke liye. Pas jis ne yeh sab paida kiya, woh tumhein dobara paida karne se aajiz nahin.
34: Pas jab doosra phoonka aayega, jo apni hebat se har cheez ko dhanp lega, aur faisla ho jayega.
35: Us din jab woh aayega, insan yaad karega ke us ne kaise aamaal aage bheje thay, neik ya bure.
36: Aur jahannum laayi jayegi aur sab ke saamne khol kar rakh di jayegi.
37: Pas jis ne hadd se barh kar gumrahi ikhtiyar ki,
38: aur fani duniya ki zindagi ko hamesha rehne wali aakhirat par tarjeeh di,
39: to beshak jahannum hi us ka thikana hai, jis mein woh panaah lega.
40: Aur jo apne Rubb ke saamne khare hone se dara aur apne aap ko un khwahishon se roka jinhein Allah ne haraam kiya, to jannat hi us ka thikana hai, jis mein woh panaah lega.
41: Aur jo apne Rubb ke saamne khare hone se dara aur apne aap ko un khwahishon se roka jinhein Allah ne haraam kiya, to jannat hi us ka thikana hai, jis mein woh panaah lega.
42: Aey Rasool ﷺ, qayamat ko jhutlane wale aap se poochte hain: “Qayamat kab aayegi?”
43: Aap ko us ka koi ilm nahin jo aap unhein bata sakein, aur na yeh aap ke mansab ke laiq hai, kyunke aap ka kaam sirf us ki tayyari hai.
44: Qayamat ka poora ilm sirf aap ke Rubb ke paas hai.
45: Aap sirf us shaks ko daraane wale hain jo qayamat se darta hai, kyunke wohi aap ke daraane se faida uthata hai.
46: Jis din woh qayamat ko apni aankhon se dekhenge, to unhein lagega ke duniya ki zindagi mein woh ek shaam ya ek subah se zyada na thehre thay.
